newsitem.title: USA: BE Aerospace sees improved 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: BE Aerospace sees improved 2nd half.

text.p: BE Aerospace Inc said on Tuesday it expects results of the second half of the fiscal year to "substantially exceed" those of the first half of the year.
In the first six months of the fiscal year, the company reported a profit of $3.3 million, or $0.19 a share, on sales of $200.3 million.
The company's fiscal year ends in February 1997.
The company said the recovery of the airline industry and increased profitability in the business has led to an increase in airliner refurbishment and retrofit programs.
